subtitle: Sharing, kit, care
question: Who looks after the meadow?
promise: In this unit you will share the kit, carry it safely, play fairly and use kind words. The meadow stays good when everyone helps.
learn: Use kind words when someone is stuck

title: Taking turns
text: One hoop, two bodies. Decide who goes first. Then swap.
rows: We both had the same time

title: Carrying kit
text: A hoop goes at your side, both paws on it. A bench takes two carriers, one at each end. A mat rolls, it does not drag.
say: Give the heavy things two carriers every time, and say who carries which end.

text: The hall, when everyone has gone home.
Carry one piece of kit across the hall with a partner. Put it down where it belongs. Then do it again, faster.

title: Ask for help
text: If something is too heavy, say so. If you are stuck, ask. Both are the right thing to do.
Rowan holds the door open. Everybody goes out.
